Sam thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. Life is full of small surprises. Sam drinks water after doing sports. Tomatoes grow faster in the greenhouse.
Sam hopes to visit Tokyo one day. Last Monday, Sam and Tom went to the flower market. Sam spent the weekend at the library. In fact, they installed solar panels on the roof.
Tom is interested in reading. They took many photos at the camping site. Sam learned a lot about math. Best of all, water freezes at 32 degrees on the Fahrenheit scale.
Sam borrowed a book about math from the library. There are always many people at the camping site. It takes twenty minutes to get to the flower market by bike.
